headline: US Expands Chip Export Restrictions in Southeast Asia to Target China
summary: New US trade rules restrict semiconductor exports and access to computing power across Southeast Asia, targeting access heavily relied upon by China.
why: The US semiconductor sector and global technology supply chains are subject to regulatory restrictions governing international trade and microchip access.
why_moved: Export controls on computing hardware directly constrain revenue potential and supply chain access for tech companies in Asia and the US.
